neighbours.label: A technical term for a physical state or symmetry property (saturation, polarisation, enrichment, parity violation), vs ordinary physical descriptions in the same settings
fire: Above a certain field strength, the iron core goes into saturation.
The experiment found a small parity violation in the weak interaction.
The crystal turns the beam into polarized light at one angle.
The uranium is enriched before it is loaded into the reactor.
In the photo editor, lower the saturation to make colors softer.
The detector measures the polarization of the incoming photons.
Magnetic saturation limits how much power the transformer can handle.
They produced an isotopically enriched sample for the test.
quiet: Above a certain temperature, the iron core starts to glow red.
The experiment found a small change in the weight of the sample.
The crystal bends the beam of light at one angle.
The uranium is stored in a steel drum before it is shipped.
In the photo editor, crop the edges to make the picture smaller.
The detector measures the energy of the incoming photons.
Heat limits how much power the transformer can handle.
They produced a large sample for the test.

predictions: saturation / polarized / enriched / violation 0.2-0.45; the same lab settings with plain words under 0.15.
notes: Card: ' saturation' x3, unpolar|ised, enriched, parity violation, polar|imeter. Probe: enriched 0.450, parity violation 0.410, core saturation 0.348, hue saturation 0.197, polarised 0.198; plain controls 0.016-0.148 ('heats up at high current' 0.148 is close).
